doc.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Learning piano from a barber in Tipton, Indiana
summary: Bunch recalls a barber teaching kids piano in ten lessons, and playing with adults by thirteen.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I wanted to ask, when did you first start playing piano and what led you to that?

Well I had a different sort of beginning from a lot of people in this business. I’m from a small town in Indiana, you know, a very small town, and all of a sudden along about when I was about eleven years old, a guy moved in to town. He was a barber, and he taught kids how to play the piano in ten easy lessons. Learn how to play the piano in ten easy lessons. And the kids loved this guy. George Johnson was his name, and he was just great with children. And I turned out to be one of his prized students, you know? I learned very quickly and from the time I was thirteen years old I was playing with adults around Indiana. I thought I was a big shot.
Tipton, Indiana. It’s still a small town.
